title: FIRST SWING HEROICS
description: New characters now get a polished opening combat kit with weighty basic attacks, forgiving animation cancels, and a starter ultimate that makes the tutorial boar look legally dramatic.
consequence: The first swing arrives before the wiki.

title: HANDMADE TOOL GRIP
description: Starter tools now gain small grip marks, weight shifts, and repair scars as players use them, making the same axe feel gradually personal instead of immediately replaceable.
consequence: The axe starts remembering the hand.

title: NEON STARTER CONFETTI
description: The opening mission now floods each pickup with rarity beams, splash text, weapon callouts, and a complimentary victory pose before the player has learned where crouch lives.
consequence: The first pickup comes with a parade permit.

title: PRE-RACE MIRROR CALIBRATION
description: Before the first event, drivers must manually adjust seat height, mirror angles, steering deadzone, brake pressure, and dashboard brightness inside a silent garage tutorial.
consequence: The festival starts by asking the chair for consent.
